main_body: wooden water trough filled with water
top_band: row 4 back rim (light brown), rows 5-8 water surface (4 shades of blue with white sparkles), rows 9-10 front rim (light/medium brown) = 7 rows total (rows 4-10)
evidence: Reading down a middle column: row 4 is the back wooden rim (1px), rows 5-8 show the visible interior water surface (4px tall, shaded in 4 blue bands), rows 9-10 form the front wooden rim (2px), row 11 is a dark eave shadow under the overhanging rim, and rows 12-14 show the recessed wooden front panels with vertical dividers and a dark base line.

style.evidence: The trough consists almost entirely of straight horizontal bands of flat colour (rows 4, 5, 6-7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12-13 are uniform horizontal strips with no wood grain, knots, or per-plank shading variation, and only 4 single-pixel white dots on the water). Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, which have speckled wood grain, dithered stone blocks, and rich multi-tone shading, this piece is geometric and flat-filled.
